title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively removing some features from the model.

title: Effect on Model Bias
text: When LASSO regularization is applied, the model becomes simpler as some coefficients are reduced to zero. This simplification can lead to an increase in bias.

title: Analyzing Bias with LASSO
text: Consider how reducing the complexity of the model by setting some coefficients to zero might affect the model's ability to fit the training data.
